name: Royal Grilled Fish
effect:
Increases all party members' DEF by 215–308 and healing effectiveness by 6–10% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
description: A fish served whole from head to tail, and a dish that reflects the heartiness and quiet dignity of the frozen north. The fish is first marinated before grilling, then garnished with sides before serving. With a recipe said to have originated in Zapolyarny Palace, this elaborately prepared dish has since become a must-have at banquets across Snezhnaya.

suspicious.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 215 and healing effects by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
suspicious.description: A fish served whole from head to tail. Clumps of sauce cling to its surface, making for a rather unappetizing sight. The flesh is so overdone, you may as well be gnawing on a tree root dug up from Snezhnaya's frozen soil... It's probably best to consign this to "exile" before it ruins a banquet entirely.

delicious.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 308 and healing effects by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
delicious.description: A fish served whole from head to tail. Beneath its golden grilled crust is flesh so delicate and tender it practically melts in your mouth, with a rich cream sauce that blooms across the palate with every savory bite. Surely even the most taciturn of Snezhnayan nobles would be moved to wax lyrical should this dish grace their banquet table.
